The '''queen''' of [[Thuruht]], a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive, resided in the [[Celestial Palace]] on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Reo system)|astronomical object]] in the [[Reo system/Legends|Reo system]].

In [[44 ABY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] [[Raynar Thul]], [[Lowbacca]], [[Tekli]], and their accompanying [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], personally met with the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] so that they could ask her how to stop [[Abeloth]]. As it was the Thuruht nest that had entrapped Abeloth on [[Abeloth's planet|her prison planet]] thousands of years before, the Knights had looked to her for information as to how Abeloth could possibly be defeated. When the Knights informed her that Abeloth was loose in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Queen had the entire nest prepare for the end of times.
